sections.title: Create and read back test
sections.what: Creates a synthetic case and reads it back to confirm it saved.
sections.why: Confirms case creation works without an AI key.
sections.watch_out: The test relies on the environment not having the OpenAI key set.

summary: Regression test that creating a synthetic case works without an OpenAI key and that the new case can be read back.
purpose: Makes sure case creation does not depend on an AI service.
why: Likely reason: prevents a return of an earlier problem where creation needed an outside key.
how: Sends a create request with district, circle, village, khata, and nickname, then reads the case back by id.
risks: The test assumes the OpenAI key is not set in the environment. It does not set it explicitly.
debug: Check the case creation route and the case service if this test fails.
